name: openGym
title: openGym: free Hevy Pro alternative
hook: Hevy Pro charges you twenty four bucks a year to track your workouts. This app does it for free.

features.intro: It's a gym tracker that lives on your phone.
features.say: Thousands of exercises, each with an animated demo.
Log every set, then see your heatmap, charts and records.
Start with a ready-made plan, or import your history from Strong, Hevy or FitNotes.

caption:
Hevy Pro charges $24/year. openGym tracks your workouts for free 🏋️

✅ Thousands of exercises with animated demos
✅ Log sets, supersets and warm-ups
✅ Heatmap, charts and personal records
✅ Import from Strong, Hevy and FitNotes
✅ No account, no server, no subscription, 100% free

💻 Android
ℹ️ The phone app is Android-only and installed from the APK on GitHub (it's not on the Play Store). iPhone needs self-hosting and adding the web app to your home screen.

Comment "GYM" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
